WITH loss AS (
  SELECT c.Insurable_Object_Identifier AS obj_id,
         SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_losses
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim AS c
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.claim_amount AS ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acme_insurance.main.loss_payment lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM acme_insurance.main.loss_reserve lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
  GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
claimed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Insurable_Object_Identifier AS obj_id
  FROM acme_insurance.main.claim
),
prem AS (
  SELECT pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier AS obj_id,
         SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS written_premium
  FROM acme_insurance.main.policy_amount AS pa
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.premium AS pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN acme_insurance.main.policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
   AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  GROUP BY pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier
)
SELECT io.Insurable_Object_Identifier AS insured_object_id,
       la.Line_1_Address AS street_address,
       COALESCE(l.incurred_losses, 0) AS incurred_losses,
       p.written_premium,
       COALESCE(l.incurred_losses, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(p.written_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM claimed AS cl
JOIN acme_insurance.main.insurable_object AS io ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier = cl.obj_id
LEFT JOIN loss AS l ON l.obj_id = cl.obj_id
JOIN prem AS p ON p.obj_id = cl.obj_id
LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.geographic_location AS gl ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
LEFT JOIN acme_insurance.main.location_address AS la ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
ORDER BY loss_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500
